summary: A large alchemist's cauldron set into a furnace: a big-bellied black cast-iron pot with a rolled lip, copper… joints fire_door, stir; options brew, pot; sockets ladle, steam, fire.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.alchemy_cauldron_large or place "prefab": "alchemy_cauldron_large" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
